description: Look up Ford's FINANCING offers for a VIN — promotional APR programs and lease programs — plus Ford's own view of cash incentives. Use this when the customer asks about financing, monthly payments, APR, leasing, or 'what's the best deal', and BEFORE building a proposal for a new Ford: many units qualify for promotional rates far below standard financing (0.9% has been seen on F-150s), which get_vehicle_rebates does not carry. Requires the customer's full name and home address — Ford will not return offers without them, so ask the customer first (e.g. 'Want me to check for additional Ford incentives and special financing? I'll need your name and address'). CRITICAL: promotional APR and cash are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE — taking a low rate means taking less cash; present them as a choice, never added together. Quote an APR only with its credit tier and term band. Programs listed as conditional require the customer to qualify (trade-in, brand loyalty, proof of ownership) — mention them as possible additional savings, never as guaranteed. If the tool reports found=false, use get_vehicle_rebates and do NOT tell the customer there are no offers.
name: get_ford_offers
